rounds.notes:
# ⚡ Round 1

---
## ❇️ Powers and Items
[Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) was nerfed but will still be our bread and butter for healing, currency generation, and for Supply Surge targets in later rounds.

Grab some weapon power, speed, and survivability. 

---

## 🧊 Playstyle

With [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) being a bit weaker than before and our healing being weak in round one, I will prioritize my primary beam target and let my secondary beam die out sometimes in order to keep someone alive longer.

# ⚡ Round 2

---
## ❇️ Powers and Items
Always go with weapon power/speed and armor to build up some currency.

If your team is doing very well:
[Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) + [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) is enough.

If you're dying a lot:
- Pick up [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016)
- Mix and match weapon speed/power items to fit your financial state.

I know a lot of people love [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e), personally I love [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) more for the move speed.

---

## 🧊 Playstyle

Your playstyle shouldn't change as much, except now you can refresh your beams more you have more weapon power to keep two targets alive at once.

# ⚡ Round 3

---
## ❇️ Powers and Items
Here's where the fun starts. Grab [Supply Surge](item_35d75d9e-66b7-426a-b92d-9dfd72ee5fbb).

Start building healing and cooldown reduction, unless you're getting hard focused and dying a lot, in which case ditch cooldown reduction and build healing and survivability.

I love using [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) with [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f).

---

## 🧊 Playstyle
Pick a **primary surge target**, and focus on their cooldown usage throughout the match. Remember to wait until their ability is over to use surge, or you'll waste it.

Remember your secondary beam from [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) also is affected by [Supply Surge](item_35d75d9e-66b7-426a-b92d-9dfd72ee5fbb), but in the beginning when you have less cooldown reduction it's much more effective to focus on mainly one target at a time, the secondary target is a bonus. 
If you have more than one S tier surge target, try to beam them both as much as possible.

You also want to try and maximize the weapon power stacks of [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) and always try to keep it at 3 stacks so you can have more weapon power.

### 💡 Yes, there is a lot to track now!
On top of your regular support gameplay, you are now juggling two beam targets with [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) while tracking teammates cooldowns to prioritize surge targets with [Supply Surge](item_35d75d9e-66b7-426a-b92d-9dfd72ee5fbb) and also trying to keep up 3 weapon stacks with [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448). If this is overwhelming, just focus on staying alive, healing, and surging one person until you get used to everything.

# ⚡ Round 4

---
## ❇️ Powers and Items

#### The core of round 4 will be:
[Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) - weapon power and cooldown reduction

[Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) - weapon power and cooldown reduction

[Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) - survivability

I add in [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) for more cooldown reduction if I don't need more healing or survivability.

---


#### If you need more survivability:

[Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) - also helps with cooldown reduction

[Vishkar Condensor](item_086a91da-b65d-4047-8fc7-28a992078b1d) - great for affordable survivability.

[Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d) if you have enough money.

---

#### If you need more healing:

[Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) - works very well with [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448)

[Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48) can help speed up healing.

[Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054), [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e). [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) are great affordable options.

---


#### If you just want to be crazy and add even more cooldown reduction:

[Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98)

---

## 🧊 Playstyle
This is the same playstyle as last round except you should be able to use supply surge more frequently, and/or heal more."
By this round I am usually more comfortable to pay even more attention to my **secondary supply surge target**.

# ⚡ Round 5

---
## ❇️ Powers

There are a ton of builds you can go from here, this is all very situational.

#### My favorites/my most reliable:
[Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1) and [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) both can help keep teammates alive. [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) does benefit from cooldown reduction as you can apply it more, and if you plan on going [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) in the last round it compliments that perfectly.

#### If you have enough heals, you can maximize supply surge with:
[Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591), which gives you the ability to surge everyone every time you res. When you res, you have Valkyrie, so now you can surge everyone on your team. This is not worth it if there isn't enough sustain already, you can't get a resurrect off due to their dive composition, or if other members of your team can't even benefit from surge anyway.
[Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591) will also go well with [First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) in round 7.

#### If you are dying a lot:
Just pick up [Serenity](item_c6e1c072-ff50-467e-b59f-9506baea10c1).

#### If you can afford building up ability power now:
[The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) alone can be helpful for some cash generation even without [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4). Keep in mind it doesn't heal a TON without ability power, but if you are confident you can scale up, you can go with [First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) for round 7 which scales with ability power. 


---
## ❇️ Items

Cooldown reduction should be fine sitting at at least 15% at this point. If you have multiple teammates that really benefit from supply surge, it's totally fine to push cooldown reduction even further up, or if you're confident you can get a lot of resses off and your team needs those resses. Overall though, you want to increase weapon power and speed. 

If you're struggling to survive, build up survivability.

If you picked up [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) You can try to build SOME ability power but you likely can't afford it yet or you won't have enough slots.

### Be sure to keep [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448), [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) no matter what.


---

Best is: [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0).

For weapon power: [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a)

For weapon speed: [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48)

For cooldown reduction: [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) - only if you have excess money and enough survivability. [Resurrection Rangefinder](item_99baffec-51b5-42e4-be61-e29f3de8219f) only if you have excess money and already build WP or survivability, or you picked [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591).

For survivability: [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016)[Vishkar Condensor](item_086a91da-b65d-4047-8fc7-28a992078b1d)[Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d)

### Whambulance only:

If you want to build ability power... 

[Multi-tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) is great since it also gives cooldown reduction. 

[Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) can compliment the build well if you have enough cash, as it helps your staff do some extra healing every time you guardian angel, which results in some burst healing with ability GA + weapon power. 

[Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) is great for surviving against a Winston and works really well with whambulance.

---

## 🧊 Playstyle

### 💡 *Stay focused on healing and supply surging.*
No matter what power you get, unless it's [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9), your playstyle should be around the same. Remember, your primary goal is still to **heal** and **supply surge**. It can get overwhelming if you're a new player now if you're balancing Triage, Supply Surge, And Threads of Fate as well as [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448). 

Keep focused on your primary and secondary target for surge with [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb), while tapping GA as much as you can for [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) without dying or wasting it if you're in a dire situation. If you have [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4), stop spamming GA as much and save it to apply Triage whenever you can.

If you got [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) you just want to maximize your distance to your targets as much as possible, and be moving around as much as possible to apply some GA healing, while keeping an eye on your supply surge targets.

round_upgrades.notes: If your team already has the sustain or you have a tank does consistent damage frontline, this can be really great to help keep them alive between supply surges.
If your team needs more healing, triage unit can work great with cooldown reduction as you can apply triage more frequently, and you can build this into whambulance in round 7.
If you are able to get off enough resses AND your team comp benefits from Supply Surge, getting resses to activate valk then applying supply surge can be very powerful.
If you are dying a lot, pick Serenity.
If you picked whambulance and have enough currency, this is a pretty good item.
If you got Whambulance, this can help with AP and CDR.
If you have trouble surviving, and you got whambulance or Triage unit, this can help.

rounds.notes:
# ⚡ Round 6

---
## ❇️ Powers and Items

#### If your team needs more help:
Build into weapon power, speed, and leave cooldown reduction at around 15%.

#### If you're dying a lot: 
Build into movement and survivability.

#### If your team can benefit from more supply surge:
Build into cooldown reduction.

---

## 🧊 Playstyle
This should be the same playstyle as Round 5.

# ⚡ Round 7

---
## ❇️ Powers

The round 7 power is very flexible, and also very dependent on what you got in round 5 and what's going on in the game at this point.

#### If you got [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) or [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591):
[First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) can compliment this very well. Remember, the overhealth you get from [First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) scales with ability power. So the more ability power you have, the more overhealth you and your target will get when resurrected. Plus, you've already built into cooldown reduction, so you'll definitely be getting off some good resurrections.

#### If you got [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4), [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) is a good choice.
Whambulance healing applies to Triage Unit as well, so these two work great together especially with cooldown reduction.

#### [Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1) and [Serenity](item_c6e1c072-ff50-467e-b59f-9506baea10c1) are solid choices still if you haven't picked them.

---

## 🧊 Playstyle
There's a lot to juggle depending on what you got. Just keep remembering to focus on supply surge as that's the point of this build!

round_upgrades.notes: Especially if you got Triage Unit round 5, whambulance fits this perfectly, but  otherwise still goes great with cooldown reduction.
Distortion is still a useful round 7 power, if your dps/tank are in the frontline doing a ton of damage this can help them out.
If you are able to get off enough resses AND your team comp benefits from Supply Surge, getting resses to activate valk then applying supply surge can be very powerful.
If you built whambulance in round 5, First Responder scales with ability power, so now you have two powers that scales.
